title: receipt-accurate objective resource and output reporting
implementation: Separate the requested output character ceiling from invocation-receipt output bytes; preserve matching resource-linkage identities in condition and progression reports while leaving ledger reconciliation and physical measurements unknown.
positive_control: Verified invocation receipts expose bounded output byte counts and exact resource linkage when both the persisted observation and receipt agree; unchanged unlinked historical receipts retain an explicit unlinked posture.
negative_control: Conflicting receipt/observation resource linkage raises objective_outcome_resource_linkage_mismatch; no resource quantity is inferred from output size, invocation count, or requested generation budget.

checks.whitespace_check: git diff --check unavailable because exact-source workspace has no .git metadata; files were source-reviewed and compiled

limitations: invocation receipt linkage is not an independent reconciliation against the resource ledger
CPU, GPU, energy, and generated-token measurements remain unknown in this result inspector
fixture inference does not demonstrate model acquisition, transfer, or performance improvement
next_dependency: trace task-family examples and evaluator/source identities through the task descriptor, scored run, and next-tick World-State feedback without exposing the private oracle

publication.remote_readback: branch, tree, and all changed blobs verified by exact GitHub reads
